NVIDIA HGX AI Factory components (H100 SXM memory type)

variants.name: H100 SXM

notes: NVIDIA's current H100 product page publishes SXM and NVL. It does not publish a separate 80 GB PCIe row. Cloud offers labelled H100 PCIe are kept as their own price rows and are not treated as NVL unless the provider says so.

variants.name: H200 SXM
notes: NVIDIA states the H200 is the first GPU with HBM3e and prints 141 GB at 4.8 TB/s. The specification table is marked preliminary and may change.

variants.name: H200 NVL
notes: NVL NVLink figure is the per-GPU 2- or 4-way NVLink bridge bandwidth printed on the H200 product page.

sources.label: NVIDIA DGX B200 product page (8-GPU system totals)
NVIDIA HGX AI Factory components (per-GPU B200 SXM)

variants.name: B200 SXM
variants.tdpW: Configurable up to 1000W (HGX B200 PCF summary)
notes: NVIDIA publishes 180 GB HBM3e and up to 8 TB/s per B200 SXM GPU. DGX B200 lists 1,440 GB and 64 TB/s across eight GPUs, which matches 180 GB and 8 TB/s each.
Some cloud price rows print 192 GB. That is the provider's published VRAM, not a figure we take from NVIDIA's B200 SXM documentation.
NVIDIA system pages publish aggregate FP4/FP8 petaFLOPS for eight-GPU boards. A single-GPU FP64 figure is not published on the pages cited here, so it stays not published.
